After an EA stage failure, the orchestrator still loads existing EA, metric and Terrain50 files and computes numeric_success from payload statuses rather than current stage exits or a generation token.
014 _run invokes EA, metric, Terrain50 and web subprocesses without a timeout.
014 _write writes directly to final JSON paths, so interruption can expose truncated documents.
Branch, page, task and attempt checks run only when environment values are non-empty; omitted values proceed.
After a failed numeric stage, the entrypoint loads an existing final output and can copy stale row, coverage or web fields into a blocked summary.
The timeout wrapper does not establish or terminate a Windows process group/job for descendant stages.
An invalid configured base is swallowed and the verifier silently probes default loopback locations.
Expected operation rows are parsed but not required to be positive and contract-bounded; zero or negative values weaken the floor.
Catalogue HTML is read without a byte bound or final-host, media-type and publication-identity validation.
Authority downloads stream directly to their final ZIP path; interruption can leave a partial file in the reusable workspace.
